title: Minerva Mills Ltd. v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Minerva Mills Ltd. v. Union of India, (1980) 3 SCC 625
content.facts: Challenge to clauses of the Forty-second Amendment that enlarged Parliament's amending power and subordinated fundamental rights to specified Directive Principles.
questionsBeforeCourt: Whether unlimited amending power and the destruction of the harmony between Parts III and IV damage the basic structure
content.holding: Parliament's amending power is limited. Harmony between fundamental rights and Directive Principles is part of the basic structure.
content.ratioDecidendi: Kesavananda's basic-structure limit is not an empty slogan. Clauses that confer unlimited amending power or destroy the balance between Parts III and IV are void.
content.presentLegalPosition: Minerva Mills remains a controlling restatement of limited amending power and of the Parts III/IV balance.
